summary: S-1 meets C-1 through C-5. The diff touches only src/notes.mjs and tests/notes.test.mjs, both in the slice paths. createNote is unchanged: it rejects a blank title (C-1) and assigns id, trimmed title, body, tags and createdAt (C-2, now covered by a new test). listNotes sorts by createdAt descending with an id tie-break (C-3), builds its result with filter before sort so the store is never returned or reordered (C-4), and filters by tag case-insensitively when { tag } is given (C-5). npm test ran 5 tests: 5 pass, 0 fail. No secrets, no non-English prose, no block or major findings. One note on the locale-sensitive localeCompare sort key.

findings.issue: The sort compares ISO createdAt strings with localeCompare, which depends on the runtime locale and collation. For the uniform ISO format createNote writes, a plain string comparison gives the same order and does not depend on locale.
findings.suggestion: Optional: replace b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt) with a plain comparison. Not required for C-3 as written.

evidence.quote: if (!title || !title.trim()) throw new Error("title is required");

criteria.note: createNote is not changed by the diff. Test 'createNote requires a title' passes.
New test asserts id, trimmed title, body, tags and a parseable createdAt. Passes.
Sorted by createdAt descending, tie-break by id descending. The test 'listNotes returns newest first' passes and also checks that the input store keeps its order.
filter always creates a new array before sort runs, so the returned value is never the store. Test 'listNotes returns a copy' passes.
Both sides are lowercased. The test covers stored tags 'Work', 'work' and 'WORK', queries 'work' and 'Work', and a non-matching tag that returns an empty list.
